get_working_directory.desc: Return the server's current working directory, OS, and hostname. Call this first to orient yourself in the filesystem before reading or writing files.

run_command.desc: Execute a shell command and return combined stdout+stderr. Timeout default: 60 s, max: 600 s.

params.command: Command to run (via sh -c on Unix, cmd /C on Windows)
params.cwd: Working directory. Defaults to server's working directory.
params.timeout_seconds: Seconds before killing the command. Default: 60, max: 600.
params.env: Extra environment variables as ["KEY=value", ...]. Merged with current env.
params.max_output_bytes: Truncate output to this many bytes. Default: no limit.
params.stdin: Content piped to the command's standard input.
params.allow_nonzero_exit: Return non-zero exit codes as success instead of error. Default: false.
params.detach: Start the process fully detached (new session via setsid on Unix). Returns immediately with the PID — output is not captured. Use list_processes to check status. Ignores timeout_seconds, stdin, and max_output_bytes. Default: false.

open_in_app.desc: Open a file, directory, or URL in the default system application. Cross-platform: uses open on macOS, xdg-open on Linux, start on Windows. Non-blocking — returns immediately. Prefer this over running open/xdg-open via run_command.

params.target: File path, directory path, or URL to open
